title: More context still occupies a finite space.

steps.title: Start at the same zero
steps.description: Each bar uses the same 0–100 scale. A longer bar represents a larger allocation within this illustrative budget.

steps.title: Account for the whole
steps.description: 15 instructions + 45 evidence + 25 history + 15 output = 100 units. These four categories exhaust the example budget.

steps.title: Make the tradeoff visible
steps.description: If the budget stays at 100, adding 10 units to history leaves 10 fewer units for the other categories. This is arithmetic, not a prediction of model quality.
